import json, os, urllib.request, urllib.error
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
PW = "94abad8b-fbe2-4e67-9c64-d9b586dd2653"
req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai/v1/pathway/%s/version/123" % PW, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
    body = json.loads(r.read().decode())
graph = body.get("data") if isinstance(body.get("data"), dict) else body
json.dump(graph, open("live-v123.json", "w"), indent=1)
print("FETCHED live v123: %d nodes, %d edges" % (len(graph.get("nodes") or []), len(graph.get("edges") or [])))

draft = json.load(open("/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR26/gl-round26-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json"))

def index(g):
    nodes = {str(n.get("id")): n for n in (g.get("nodes") or []) if isinstance(n, dict)}
    edges = {}
    for e in (g.get("edges") or []):
        if isinstance(e, dict):
            k = str(e.get("id") or (str(e.get("source")) + ">" + str(e.get("target"))))
            edges[k] = e
    return nodes, edges

dn, de = index(draft)
ln, le = index(graph)
print("=== NODE DIFF (draft vs live) ===")
diff_nodes = 0
for nid in sorted(set(dn) | set(ln)):
    a, b = dn.get(nid), ln.get(nid)
    if a is None:
        print("NODE %s: ONLY-IN-LIVE" % nid); diff_nodes += 1; continue
    if b is None:
        print("NODE %s: ONLY-IN-DRAFT" % nid); diff_nodes += 1; continue
    if json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True):
        continue
    diff_nodes += 1
    keys = set((a.get("data") or {}).keys()) | set((b.get("data") or {}).keys())
    changed = [k for k in sorted(keys) if json.dumps((a.get("data") or {}).get(k), sort_keys=True) != json.dumps((b.get("data") or {}).get(k), sort_keys=True)]
    top = [k for k in sorted(set(a) | set(b)) if k != "data" and json.dumps(a.get(k), sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(b.get(k), sort_keys=True)]
    print("NODE %s differs: data-fields=%s top-level=%s" % (nid, changed, top))
print("DIFF_NODES=%d" % diff_nodes)
diff_edges = 0
for k in sorted(set(de) | set(le)):
    a, b = de.get(k), le.get(k)
    if a is None or b is None or json.dumps(a, sort_keys=True) != json.dumps(b, sort_keys=True):
        diff_edges += 1
print("DIFF_EDGES=%d" % diff_edges)
print("DIFF_DONE")
